questions.q: What total does the text state for this list: All Muslims present at Badr, or given a share?
questions.why: Stated at vol. 1, p. 706. The extraction found 321 names.

questions.q: Which groups does Ibn Isḥāq's list add up from?
Whose voice adds names that the first author did not count?

questions.q: On which weekday does the text place it?
questions.why: "on Friday, the morning of the seventeenth of Ramaḍān" (vol. 1, p. 626).

questions.q: Under the simple crescent rule, did any computed lunation give that weekday?
questions.why: before: Monday 13 February 624; tabular: Tuesday 13 March 624; after: Thursday 12 April 624.
